title: Wildfly: broker-side PushTelemetry API (KIP-714) validates only the compressed size of a client's metrics payload…
description: CVE-2026-111073 is a vulnerability in Wildfly affecting the broker-side PushTelemetry API (KIP-714). The API only validates the compressed size of a client's metrics payload, potentially leading to a denial of service. This flaw affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r2 and 2.10.0-r15. A patch is available in these fixed versions.
